newsitem.title: USA: Columbia/HCA named in shareholder lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Columbia/HCA named in shareholder lawsuit.

text.p: Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp is the target of a shareholder lawsuit following federal investigations into the hospital company's business practices, a law firm said on Tuesday.

The law firm of Wechsler Harwood Halebian & Feffer LLP said it filed a complaint in U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Tennessee, seeking recovery of damages for purchasers of the company's common stock between April 8, 1994 and March 19, 1997.
Columbia/HCA officials were not immediately available for comment.
The company last month said federal agents were investigating its El Paso, Texas, facilities, in a probe that covered a broad range of records and documents.
